name: Displace
description: Displaces the first input by the brightness of two map inputs (x and y).

inputs.name: xmap
inputs.description: Horizontal displacement map (same size as the first input)

inputs.name: ymap
inputs.description: Vertical displacement map (same size as the first input)

params.name: edge
params.description: What happens beyond the edge: 0 = blank (black), 1 = smear (repeat the edge), 2 = wrap, 3 = mirror
